#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Node {
    std::vector<struct Edge*> edges;
    int index;
};

struct Edge {
    bool forward;
    Node* from;
    Node* to;
    long long flow;
    const long long capacity;
    Edge* dual;
    long long cost;
    Edge(Node* s, Node* d, long long c, bool f) : from(s), to(d), capacity(c), flow(0), forward(f), cost(0) {}
    long long remaining() { return capacity - flow; }
    void addFlow(long long amount) {
        flow += amount;
        dual->flow -= amount;
    }
};

class MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    std::vector<Node*> nodes;
    MaxFlowSolver() {}
    Node* addNode() {
        Node* n = new Node();
        n->index = (int)nodes.size();
        nodes.push_back(n);
        return n;
    }
    void link(Node* n1, Node* n2, long long capacity) {
        link(n1, n2, capacity, 1);
    }
    void link(Node* n1, Node* n2, long long capacity, long long cost) {
        Edge* e12 = new Edge(n1, n2, capacity, true);
        Edge* e21 = new Edge(n2, n1, 0, false);
        e12->dual = e21;
        e21->dual = e12;
        n1->edges.push_back(e12);
        n2->edges.push_back(e21);
        e12->cost = cost;
        e21->cost = -cost;
    }
    long long getMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) {
        // To be implemented in derived classes
        return 0;
    }
};

class MinCostMaxFlowSolver : public MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    virtual std::pair<long long, long long> getMinCostMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) = 0;
};

class EdmondsKarp : public MinCostMaxFlowSolver {
public:
    long long minCost;
    static const long long INF = LLONG_MAX / 4;
    std::pair<long long, long long> getMinCostMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) override {
        long long maxflow = getMaxFlow(src, snk);
        return {maxflow, minCost};
    }
    long long getMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) override {
        int n = (int)nodes.size();
        int source = src->index;
        int sink = snk->index;
        long long flow = 0;
        long long cost = 0;
        long long potential[10000]; // assuming max nodes less than 10000
        while (true) {
            Edge* parent[10000];
            long long dist[10000];
            for (int i=0; i<n; i++) dist[i] = INF;
            memset(parent, 0, sizeof(parent));
            dist[source] = 0;
            typedef std::pair<long long, int> Item;
            std::priority_queue<Item, std::vector<Item>, std::greater<Item>> que;
            que.emplace(0, source);
            while (!que.empty()) {
                auto [d, v] = que.top(); que.pop();
                if (d != dist[v]) continue;
                for (auto e : nodes[v]->edges) {
                    long long temp = dist[v] + e->cost + potential[v] - potential[e->to->index];
                    if (e->capacity > e->flow && dist[e->to->index] > temp) {
                        dist[e->to->index] = temp;
                        parent[e->to->index] = e;
                        que.emplace(temp, e->to->index);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (parent[sink] == nullptr) break;
            for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
                if (parent[i] != nullptr) potential[i] += dist[i];
            }
            long long augFlow = LLONG_MAX;
            for (int i=sink; i != source; i = parent[i]->from->index) {
                augFlow = std::min(augFlow, parent[i]->capacity - parent[i]->flow);
            }
            for (int i=sink; i != source; i = parent[i]->from->index) {
                Edge* e = parent[i];
                e->addFlow(augFlow);
                cost += augFlow * e->cost;
            }
            flow += augFlow;
        }
        minCost = cost;
        return flow;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int N, M, K, C, D;
    cin >> N >> M >> K >> C >> D;
    EdmondsKarp solver;
    std::vector<int> people(K);
    for (int i=0; i<K; i++) {
        cin >> people[i];
        people[i]--;
    }
    Node* src = solver.addNode();
    Node* snk = solver.addNode();
    int amt = 150;
    Node* timeNodes[100][150]; // assuming max N=100
    for (int i=0; i<N; i++) {
        for (int j=1; j<amt; j++) {
            timeNodes[i][j] = solver.addNode();
            if (j > 1) {
                solver.link(timeNodes[i][j-1], timeNodes[i][j], LLONG_MAX, 0);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<K; i++) {
        solver.link(src, timeNodes[people[i]][1], 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i=1; i<amt; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<K; j++) {
            solver.link(timeNodes[0][i], snk, 1, C * i - C);
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<M; i++) {
        std::string line;
        getline(cin, line);
        if (line.empty()) {
            getline(cin, line);
        }
        std::istringstream iss(line);
        int a, b;
        iss >> a >> b;
        a--; b--;
        for (int j=1; j<amt-1; j++) {
            int prev=0;
            for (int k=1; k<=K; k++) {
                long long costVal = D * (long long)k * (long long)k - prev;
                solver.link(timeNodes[a][j], timeNodes[b][j+1], 1, costVal);
                solver.link(timeNodes[b][j], timeNodes[a][j+1], 1, costVal);
                prev = D * (long long)k * (long long)k;
            }
        }
    }
    auto [maxFlow, minCost] = solver.getMinCostMaxFlow(src, snk);
    cout << maxFlow << "\n";
    return 0;
}
